desc.zh: 用逐行约束搜索数完整解，观察计数与完整撤销。
desc.en: Count complete queen arrangements with row-by-row constraints and reversible search.

complexity: O(n·n!) time, O(n) auxiliary space; average O(1) set operations

concepts.name: counting complete search leaves
concepts.description: Only a complete nonattacking arrangement increments the count.

concepts.name: diagonal constraint sets
concepts.description: Use c, r-c, r+c to reject attacks before descending.

concepts.name: count-only backtracking
concepts.description: Restore constraints while retaining the cumulative integer, without storing boards.
